description: M5BAT Large-Scale Battery Storage System Dataset: Evaluation Operation Report 04/2023; V1 is a data set deposited in RWTH Publications by its authors Lucas Koltermann, Mauricio Eduardo Celi Cortés (RWTH Aachen). This dataset contains time series data (time, power, current, voltage, temperature, grid frequency, SOC, status) of the field operation of a stationary large-scale battery storage system in the German power grid (frequency containment reserve and 15 min intraday trading). Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
